en: The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard showing an aerial or elevated view of a village or small town surrounded by dense greenery and forest. The settlement contains several scattered houses, some with distinctive architectural features. There is handwritten text in Greek on the right edge and at the bottom, with the words 'Λεχώνια' (Lechonia) and 'Αγριά' (Agria). The website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears at the bottom right.
